Always on via Media3 single-player continuous queue; tracks with encoder delay/padding play without gaps

WindTone uses one ExoPlayer (Media3) with a continuous MediaItem queue. Media3 reads per-track encoder delay/padding and joins album splits without an audible gap when metadata is present.

There is no Media3 API to turn this off. Forcing gaps would mean inserting silence between tracks, which we deliberately do not do.

How lyrics are found:
1. Sidecar in the same Aliyun Drive folder (.lrc / .krc / .yrc / .txt)
2. Same-named lyric file next to the audio
3. Embedded lyrics (MP3 USLT/SYLT, FLAC/Ogg LYRICS, M4A ©lyr)
4. Lyrics from a same-named track in the local library (local only; no online search)

If a cloud track has none of the above, this hint is shown as-is. Put a same-named lyric file in the cloud folder, or add the song to the local library.
